source_text: Gravid or blood-fed A. gambiae s.l. adult females resting indoors were collected in houses in Akron, Porto-Novo, Benin (lat: 4.4300; long: 2.6400)... in September 2009... identified as A. gambiae s.s. M-form by PCR... The 1014F kdr frequency in wild-caught females was 0.92 (n=74).
To assess the resistance profile of the Akron population, adults (2-5 days old) reared from field-collected larvae were exposed to permethrin (0.75%), bendiocarb (0.1%) or DDT (4%) for one hour.
